1.t: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come

2.t: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—

3.t: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent

4.t: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length
4.tr: Ta'rujul malaaa'ikatu war-Roohu ilaihi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah

5.t: So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience

6.t: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible

7.t: but We see it as inevitable

8.t: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass

9.t: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool

10.t: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends

11.t: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children
11.tr: Yubassaroonahum; ya-waddul mujrimu law yaftadee min 'azaabi yawma'izim bibaneeh

14.t: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves
14.tr: Wa-man fil ardi jamee'an summa yunjeeh

15.t: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame

17.t: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺

21.t: and withholding when touched with good—

24.t: and who give the rightful share of their wealth

25.t: to the beggar and the poor

26.t: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment

27.t: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—

28.t: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—

29.t: and those who guard their chastity

30.t: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame
30.tr: Illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fa-innahum ghairu maloomeen

31.t: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors
31.tr: Famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa-ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

32.t: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants

33.t: and who are honest in their testimony

34.t: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

35.t: These will be in Gardens, held in honour

36.t: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺

37.t: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺

38.t: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss
38.tr: Ayatma'u kullum ri'im minhum any yudkhala jannata Na'eem

39.t: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from

40.t: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable
40.tr: Falaaa uqsimu bi-Rabbil mashaariqi wal-maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon

41.t: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺
41.tr: Alaaa an nubaddila khairan minhum Wa-maa nahnu bi-masbooqeen

42.t: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—
42.tr: Fazarhum yakhoodoo Wa-yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawma-humul lazee yoo'adoon

43.t: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺
43.tr: Yawma yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi siraa'an ka-anna-hum ilaa nusubiny yoofidoon

44.t: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of
44.tr: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillah; zaalikal yawmul lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon
